Migrations — Add-Migration
data.code:
# Package Manager Console in Visual Studio
Add-Migration InitialCreate

# .NET CLI
dotnet ef migrations add InitialCreate

# Add migration with output directory
dotnet ef migrations add AddEmailColumn --output-dir Migrations/Custom

data.title: Migrations — Update-Database
data.code:
# Apply pending migrations
Update-Database

# .NET CLI
dotnet ef database update

# Apply specific migration
dotnet ef database update AddEmailColumn

# Revert last migration
dotnet ef database update PreviousMigrationName

data.title: Migrations — Remove-Migration and Script
data.code:
# Remove the last migration (if not applied)
Remove-Migration

# .NET CLI
dotnet ef migrations remove

# Generate SQL script for all migrations
Script-Migration -Idempotent

# .NET CLI
dotnet ef migrations script --idempotent

data.title: Querying — FindAsync
Querying — First, FirstOrDefault, Single, SingleOrDefault
data.code:
var first = await context.Users.FirstAsync(); // throws if none
var firstOrDefault = await context.Users.FirstOrDefaultAsync(); // returns null
var single = await context.Users.SingleAsync(u => u.Email == "a@b.com"); // throws if multiple
var singleOrDefault = await context.Users.SingleOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Email == "a@b.com");

data.title: Querying — Where and Select Projection
Querying — Eager Loading Include/ThenInclude
data.code:
var posts = await context.Posts
    .Include(p => p.Author)
    .Include(p => p.Comments)
        .ThenInclude(c => c.Author)
    .OrderByDescending(p => p.CreatedAt)
    .ToListAsync();

Performance — AsSplitQuery
data.code:
// Use AsSplitQuery to avoid Cartesian explosion with multiple Includes.

var blogs = await context.Blogs
    .Include(b => b.Posts)
        .ThenInclude(p => p.Tags)
    .Include(b => b.Owner)
    .AsSplitQuery()
    .ToListAsync();

Reverse Engineering — Scaffold-DbContext
data.code:
# Package Manager Console
Scaffold-DbContext "Server=.;Database=MyDb;Trusted_Connection=True;" \
    Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer \
    -OutputDir Models -ContextDir Context \
    -Context AppDbContext \
    -Force

# .NET CLI
dotnet ef dbcontext scaffold "Server=.;Database=MyDb;Trusted_Connection=True;" \
    Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer \
    --output-dir Models --context-dir Context \
    --context AppDbContext --force
